subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below:
stimulus: A B C Many of us can the life of a dying patient By donating blood we will misconception about blood donation Blood donation is cause no harm. Every man in sound health have donate blood after every three months Donating blood save a very noble deed
guide_solution: (a) Blood donation is a very noble deed. (b) By donating blood we save the life of a dying patient. (c) Many of us have misconception about blood donation. (d) Every man in sound health can donate blood after every three months. (e) Donating blood will cause no harm.
